about: R2-CAPTAIN-ANIMATION walk (D-115: 'she should be walking calmly'): one full calm walk cycle of 12 unique painted frames in back and profile, from the v3 walking stance-gait guides (guides.json: game 1.3 m/s, cadence 105, guide cycle 1.300 m drawn at the painted scale, 0.108 m and 95.2 ms a frame; char_captain_pose_guides_v3.py.txt). The idle frames are the accepted first pilot's. All 60 guides pinned in guides.sha256 (gs://stapledons-voyage-assets/captain/<sha256>.png). Replaces the jog (art/captain-anim-v2, D-109), whose frames leave the manifest.

walk.cycle_note: In game: the guide cycle 1.2994 m / cos 29 deg (the v2 scale finding: the guide's 29 deg view draws ground distances at 823 px/m, the billboard shows painted pixels at 720 px/m). 0.1238 m and 95.2 ms a frame at 1.3 m/s; cadence 105 steps a minute.
